jobs.title: Managing Director, Innovation Banking Investor Coverage - Healthcare
jobs.description: Overview This is a hybrid role, with the expectation that time working will regularly take place inside and outside of our Boston, NYC or San Francisco office. Join SVB, a division of First Citizen’s Bank, as a part of the Investor Coverage and Business Development group in either Boston, NYC OR the Bay Area. As trusted advisors, building a supportive ecosystem for the investor community and their portfolio companies is the primary focus of our team. Responsible for delivering differentiated value and a world-class experience to the investor community, the Managing Director will work in collaboration with our broader Business Development team and Commercial Bank colleagues, upholding SVBs brand reputation and commitment to helping investors achieve their business goals. Together, Silicon Valley Bank and First Citizens offer you the strength and stability of a diversified financial institution with a 125-year tradition of service and the personalized approach of a nimble financial partner. First Citizens Bank helps personal, business, commercial and wealth clients build financial strength that lasts. Headquartered in Raleigh, N.C., First Citizens has built a unique legacy of strength, stability and long-term thinking that has spanned generations. First Citizens offers an array of general banking services including a network of more than 550 branches in 23 states and commercial banking expertise delivering best-in-class lending, leasing and other financial services coast to coast. Parent company First Citizens BancShares, Inc. (NASDAQ: FCNCA) is a top 20 U.S. financial institution with more than $200 billion in assets. Seeking a relationship management and business development professional with experience in the Life Science Healthcare industry to join our team. Primary responsibilities of the Managing Director are to build, maintain, and engage strategic relationships within the LSHC investor community to help scale and grow SVB's businesses; be an SVB ambassador; cross-sell the SVB platform by winning and retaining the best opportunities; provide strategic insight and advice to critical investor relationships and internal bank stakeholders. Based in either Boston, NYC or the Bay Area West Coast, the ideal candidate is already active in the local ecosystem, with an existing, and growing network of investors, influencers, and relevant stakeholder relationships. Responsibilities & Qualifications Duties & Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership & Business Development - Develop and execute high-level strategies for establishing and maintaining consultative relationships with top-tier venture capital firms, clients, and key decision-makers in VC/CVC firms. Lead the team in understanding and anticipating the evolving needs of VCs and portfolio companies, strengthening the organization's position in venture capital (VC) and corporate venture capital (CVC) sectors. Identify and pursue high-impact opportunities for relationship development and market share growth with active VC/CVC firms. Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction to internal teams, VCs, and clients, shaping the organization's approach to new opportunities and market trends. Develop and implement long-term strategic plans to expand the organization's reach and impact in the venture ecosystem. Portfolio Management & Industry Engagement - Oversee high-level engagements with VCs, guiding discussions on portfolio companies and ensuring seamless communication between the Relationship team and VCs. Lead the team in conducting in-depth analyses of venture-backed financings, performance, and fund creation to position the organization as an industry thought leader. Direct and optimize research processes using proprietary and third-party databases, leveraging insights to inform strategic decisions and market positioning. Represent the organization at high-profile events and speaking engagements, establishing yourself as a key thought leader in the venture ecosystem. Mentor and develop team members at all levels, building a strong talent pipeline and succession plan. Escalate issues and opportunities cross functionally, oversee strategic initiatives and participate in complex deals or escalations for existing clients. Cross-functional Collaboration and Organizational Leadership - Spearhead the review and development of global VC opportunities, creating and implementing strategic plans to expand the organization's reach and impact. Lead complex, high-stakes projects involving both internal and external partners, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Collaborate with C-suite executives and other senior leaders to align VCRM strategies with broader organizational objectives. Drive innovation in products and services, identifying and implementing transformative solutions to enhance efficiency and value delivery. Cultivate and maintain strategic partnerships with industry leaders and influential stakeholders to strengthen the organization's position in the market. Team Management and Development - Mentor a team of relationship managers and specialists. Assist in setting performance standards, conduct regular evaluations, and provide mentorship to team members. Identify skill gaps within the team and recommend implementing targeted training and development programs. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the VCRM team. Position Specific Skills: Exceptional ability in developing and maintaining executive-level relationships with external clients and internal partners. Comprehensive understanding of VC and investments landscape, with the ability to anticipate market trends. Superior communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing C-suite executives and industry leaders. Visionary strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Adept at navigating complex organizational structures and driving cross-functional collaboration. Advanced proficiency in financial analysis, market research, and data-driven decision making. Proven leadership skills with the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams. Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience in VC relationship management OR High School Diploma or GED and 12 years of experience in VC relationship management. Preferred Qualifications: Expertise: Active in relevant sectors and committed to active participation in the VC and startup community. Comfortable building long-term, sales-oriented relationships, and managing partnerships. Individual can build and maintain investor relationships, devise strategies for developing new business, and collaborate well across groups Goal Oriented: Able to meet targets and measure return on investment. Data driven. Capable of using both data and intuition to deliver results. Execution: Can develop authentic relationships with the most influential and impactful venture firms in the startup ecosystem. Actively shares viewpoints and information with colleagues and peers to form recommendations. Ensures cohesion across SVB's broad businesses and delivers timely business reviews to show progress to goals Collaborative: Influences. Has gravitas and charisma. Partners extremely well with internal colleagues and can skillfully engage in difficult external discussions with critical relationships when needed. Views SVB and the broader Business Development team as extensions of their network and uses full set of SVB resources to deliver exception results Investor Focus: Has an innate curiosity and the ability to uncover the needs and interests of strategic investors. Is personally active and respected in the marketplace with an existing and growing network of relevant stakeholders New Business: Persistent and resourceful. Able to ideate and devise new ways to engage clients and prospects. Comfortable with pipeline development and execution accountability. Can learn to cross sell SVB platform. Able to deal with difficult or dissatisfied clients. Motivated to solve issues and thinks about solutions - not problems. Brand Builder: Can represent SVB with confidence in the marketplace with a unique and informed POV. Able to converse with serial entrepreneurs, first-time founders, early stage investors, late-stage investors, and stakeholders as needed. Additional Information The base pay for this position is generally between $198,000.00 and $252,000.00 Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits. #hybrid

jobs.title: Associate I, Credit Solutions - Fintech, Innovation Banking
jobs.description: Overview This is a hybrid role, with the expectation that time working will regularly take place inside and outside of the Chicago office. At First Citizens Innovation Bank, formerly Silicon Valley Bank, you’ll do more than support innovative companies, you’ll help shape their success. With more than 40 years of experience serving the innovation economy, our teams work closely with clients across technology, life sciences, healthcare, venture capital, private equity, and other innovation-driven sectors providing specialized banking solutions, industry insights, and meaningful connections that help businesses scale and thrive. We combine deep expertise, lasting relationships and meaningful opportunities to help our clients, communities and associates move forward together. Find out more at First Citizens Innovation Banking. The Credit Solutions group manages lending/credit for a wide range of credit relationships. Leads the due diligence process and deal structuring process. Partners with the Relationship Management Team for the delivery and negotiation of credit solutions. Owns the underwriting, approval and closing process. Responsible for proactive portfolio management, including maintaining credit quality and profitability targets. Remains abreast of market, sector, and competitive trends. Engages and builds relationships with key client stakeholders to remain well-informed, and able to respond to changing circumstances while appropriately balancing client and SVB needs. Develops and delivers insights and points of view on loan types and credit/performance trends in sectors/sub-sectors. Conducts due diligence and engages in the structuring and delivery of new deals. Underwrites new loans, renewals, and credit actions related to modifications or changing risk. Supports overall lending process on new deals and modifications to existing deals, from underwriting through documentation and closing. Reviews information and communicates on clients' compliance status, changing level of risk and broader trends in portfolio. Utilizes critical thinking skills in supporting VP’s and Directors/MD’s on both recommendations and actions pertaining to pipeline and portfolio management. Completes underwriting and portfolio management with practices that meet SVB policies/procedures in terms of timeliness, completeness, consistency, and accuracy. Handles client needs by interacting with appropriate internal and external stakeholders. Develops expertise in SVB’s loan types and markets. Responsibilities & Qualifications Fintech at First Citizens Innovation Bank Fintech is a unique and specialized practice which focuses on providing a holistic set of products and services to power VC-backed Fintech companies. The 50+ person group covers the entire country and provides clients with banking, corporate debt, Warehouse facilities, Embedded Payment solutions, and more. The team additionally works cross functionally with Payments, Relationship Advisors, Compliance, and Risk partners across the bank to manage the complex nature of financial services companies. The team particularly focuses on regulated financial services companies across Lending, Real Estate, Capital Markets, Payments, NeoBanks, Wealth Management, Insurance, and Crypto. Fintech Credit Solutions – Accelerator & Growth The Fintech Credit Solutions team manages corporate lending (non-SPV) and payments exposures across the country. The team is split into an early-stage practice (Seed through ~Series D) and a late-stage practice focused on companies that have achieved material scale (~Series D through post-IPO). Fintech Accelerator and Growth provides several types of facilities including lines of credit and term loans, though is primarily focused on Venture Debt (early-stage Growth Capital Term Loans through Mezzanine facilities). The group also provides ACH and payments facilities for high volume originators. Credit Analysis and Underwriting - Preside over spreading of financial statements and analyzing financial data. Support the underwriting process by gathering and organizing relevant information. Help prepare credit memos and other underwriting documents. Participate in the assessment of credit risk and loan structuring Portfolio Management and Monitoring - Assist in monitoring existing credit relationships for compliance and performance. Help prepare regular portfolio reviews and risk assessments. Support the team in identifying potential issues within the portfolio. Contribute to the preparation of management reports on portfolio performance. Documentation and Compliance - Assist in preparing and maintaining credit files. Support the team in ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Help gather and organize documentation for credit applications and renewals. Contribute to the preparation of covenant compliance reports. Client Relationship Support - Assist in gathering client information and responding to basic client inquiries. Support team in preparing for client meetings. Help coordinate internal resources to address client needs. Contribute to the maintenance of client relationships through timely and accurate communication. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree and 1 year of experience in Credit analysis and accounting experience OR High School Diploma or GED and 5 years of experience in Credit analysis and accounting experience Preferred Education and Experience At least 2 years of credit analysis and accounting experience, ideally commercial banking Bachelor’s degree Additional Information If hired in Chicago, the base pay for this position is generally between $78,750-$105,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits. #hybrid

Responsible for supporting the underwriting and execution of debt transactions and portfolio management for sponsor finance portfolio management companies. Assists the sponsor finance team in various aspects of the credit lifecycle, including financial analysis, documentation preparation, and portfolio monitoring. Also assists with various aspects of the deal process, working closely with senior team members to provide creative late-stage and leveraged capital solutions to clients, prospects and portfolio management companies.
